university.name: Southern Alberta Institute of Technology
university.description: A leading polytechnic in Calgary offering hands-on bachelor's degrees in business, technology, construction, and hospitality. #2 ranked business school in Canada (CEOWORLD 2025). 89% graduate employment rate.

programs.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
programs.description: 4-year BBA with majors in Accounting, Financial Services, HR, Management, Marketing, and Supply Chain. #2 ranked business school in Canada.

programs.name: Bachelor of Science Construction Project Management
programs.description: 4-year degree in construction management. Accredited by CIQS and PMI-GAC.

programs.name: Bachelor of Hospitality and Tourism Management
programs.description: 4-year degree at the #1 ranked Hospitality school in Canada. Prepares for managerial and entrepreneurial roles.

programs.name: Bachelor of Applied Business Administration
programs.description: Applied business degree preparing for CPA designation with practice knowledge in taxation, accounting, auditing, and leadership.

programs.name: Bachelor of Applied Technology - GIS
programs.description: Geographic Information Systems degree for one of the fastest growing IT sectors.

programs.name: Bachelor of Applied Technology - Petroleum Engineering
programs.description: Petroleum engineering degree covering exploration, economic analysis, and facilities design.

programs.name: Bachelor of Technology - Cyber Security
programs.description: Learn to respond to and mitigate cyber threats with cutting-edge technologies.

programs.name: Bachelor of Technology - Software Development
programs.description: Full-stack development skills for improving business processes and user interactions.
